sources.paraphrase: Committee discussion says concurrent-enrolment CC codes affect online school graduation attribution: credit can follow the last submitted exit code rather than the location of the last class. This is an indexed account of the administrative issue, not verified person-level membership.

Committee discussion distinguishes graduate, nongraduate and cohort exit status, and considers FTE treatment for concurrent enrolment. A suggestion is not an adopted business rule; no new fractional attribution is applied.
